name: com.koenig-solutions/koenig-mcp
title: Koenig MCP
description: Search Koenig Solutions' IT training catalog: courses, exam codes, outlines, vendors, technologies.

tools.name: get_course_details
tools.description: Full details of ONE Koenig Solutions course: name, code, page url, vendor, technology, level, duration, overview, who should attend, prerequisites, what you will learn, curriculum, skills gained, career roles and hiring companies, exam format and cost, FAQs, course outline PDF and delivery options (1-on-1, Flexi). Accepts the course name, its course or exam code (e.g. 'PL-300', 'AZ-104T00') or its page url. match = 'exact' or 'closest'; for 'closest', other_matches lists other courses with a similar name - if the user may have meant one of them, say so. Prices and schedules are not included: give the user the course url for those.

course.description: Course name, course/exam code or course page url, e.g. 'PL-300', 'Microsoft Azure Administrator', 'AZ-104T00'. 2-300 characters.

tools.name: list_technology_courses
tools.description: All Koenig Solutions courses for a technology, as listed on that technology's page (the technology and its direct sub-technologies), the technology's own courses first, then most popular. Each course has name, code, url, vendor, level and duration. Paged: total, page, page_size, total_pages. other_technologies lists similarly named technologies the user may have meant (e.g. 'Azure' -> also 'Azure AI', 'Azure Security').

technology.description: Technology name, e.g. 'Azure', 'Kubernetes', 'Cyber Security', 'Power Platform'. 2-200 characters.

tools.name: list_vendor_courses
tools.description: All Koenig Solutions courses of a vendor (e.g. Microsoft, AWS, Cisco, Red Hat), most popular first. Each course has name, code, url, technology, level and duration. Also returns technologies: the vendor's main technologies with course counts - for a big vendor offer those to the user and use list_technology_courses to narrow down. Paged: total, page, page_size, total_pages.

tools.name: search_courses
tools.description: Search Koenig Solutions' live IT training catalog. Accepts a course name, exam or course code (e.g. 'AZ-104', 'DP-600'), technology, vendor or a short topic ('azure devops', 'oracle dba'). Returns the best-matching courses, best first, each with name, code, course page URL, technology, level, vendor and duration. Pass only the subject as keywords: for 'give me details of Azure DevOps' send 'Azure DevOps'. This tool returns a course list, not outlines, prerequisites, prices or schedules; for those, give the user the course url.

query.description: What to search for, e.g. 'Azure DevOps', 'AZ-104', 'python for data science'. 2-200 characters.

limit.description: How many courses to return, 1-25. Default 10.

vendor.description: Optional vendor to rank first, e.g. 'Microsoft', 'AWS', 'Cisco'. Other vendors still appear.
